title: Upstage: Solar Pro 4 at 70% off through October 9
body: Upstage's launch promo bills Solar Pro 4 at 30% of its standard rates - $0.09 in / $0.36 out per million - through 2026-10-09 (UTC). The catalogue's rows carry the standard rates, which apply again from October 10. Solar Mini 4 runs 50% off until October 22.
